studies.title: The banana
studies.caption: Bananas grow in clusters beneath broad leaves. People spread cultivated forms by carrying living planting material from one tropical region to another.
studies.prompt: Low upward view of a cultivated banana Musa plant, layered pseudostem, enormous broad leaves with naturally split edges, green curved bananas grouped in orderly hands and a single purple inflorescence hanging below. Melanesian garden, no woody palm trunk or coconuts, no people.
